messages:
emma_prod: Quick design check: weve got two prototype patterns for the first-run helper — a small persistent pill anchored in the corner, and a transient toast that appears once after signup. Need feedback on discoverability, interruptiveness, and a11y. attaching mocks: https://img.redwood/onboard/pill-vs-toast.png

 rafael_design: Pill wins for low-friction persistence. But it can be easy to miss if its too subtle. Recommend a short label + icon (e.g., "Start" with a spark icon) and a subtle pulse only for first 10s. Toast is higher discovery but feels interruptive and could clash with other toasts.

 lena_devex: Pill sounds better for keyboard users. If its visible on load, it must be in the tab order right after the main nav. Also make sure the pills expanded panel receives focus and is reachable by Escape to close. For the toast, wed need consistent timing and keyboard dismiss (Esc) + focus return.

 chris_research: Quick data note: in last cohort the one-time modal increased clicks by 18% but also raised early drop by 6% (people who wanted to set up infra immediately). My hypothesis: persistent pill reduces cognitive load but needs clearer CTA messaging.

 emma_prod: Good point. Let's aim for pill with one-time highlight (pulse) and an optional follow-up toast if user doesn't interact within 30s. Copy question: should CTA say "Try sample project" or "Choose a starter"?

 rafael_design: "Try a sample project" is explicit. Shorten for the pill label to "Try sample" and use the expanded panel to show "Try a sample project" as the primary CTA. Microcopy in cards: label what it showcases (chat, search, embeddings).

 lena_devex: Accessibility notes:
 - Button must have aria-expanded + aria-controls
 - If panel opens, set aria-hidden on main content to avoid double readout or use inert polyfill
 - Announce "Onboarding helper opened" in an aria-live polite region
 - Respect prefers-reduced-motion for pulse animation

 a11y-bot: Auto-scan (branch: onboard/pill) flagged: insufficient color contrast for pill text on light theme (ratio 3.2:1), missing aria-live element, pulse animation duration 2s (recommend reduce). See /a11y/1743456789-report.html

 chris_research: For sample selection, propose "Support Chat" and "Document Q&A" — they cover chat flow and embeddings/search and match top demo metrics. Also consider an inline "preview" mode (hover or small modal) so users can glance before selecting.

 emma_prod: I like preview idea but keep it lightweight. For metrics, track: click-through rate on pill, sample select rate, time-to-first-response, and bounce within signup flow. Goal: +25% sample selection without increasing drop rate.

 rafael_design: Implementation note: use a single button element with expanded state to avoid duplicate tabbable elements. Visuals: 40px height pill, 12px icon, 4px border radius. Hover and focus styles must be 3:1 visible but well aim for 4.5:1 contrast for text.

 lena_devex: QA checklist Ill add: keyboard nav, screen-reader announcement, focus return, reduced-motion, contrast checks, mobile viewport placement, and voiceover testing. Ill write steps and test cases.

 a11y-bot: Reminder: run lighthouse a11y and axe-core CI after PR.

 emma_prod: Plan: Rafael to update mocks + final copy by EOD, Lena to draft QA script, Chris to prepare sample rationale. Well flag behind feature toggle and run a 2-week experiment. Reopen thread with staging URL once ready. Thanks all :tada:
